definitions.explanation: A shop offering haircuts, shaves, and related grooming services, traditionally aimed at male customers. Distinguished from {美容院|びよういん} (beauty salon), which traditionally serves women.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{理容院|りよういん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: My father went to the barbershop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{理容院|りよういん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{安|やす}くて→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧。
examples.english: The neighborhood barbershop is cheap and quick.

examples.japanese: {理容院|りよういん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ひげ→ひげ：01332_hige⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{剃|そ}って→剃る：00384_soru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had my beard shaved at the barbershop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧{理容院|りよういん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}って→切る：02693_kiru⟧⟦もらっている→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather gets his hair cut at the same barbershop every month.

notes:
{理容院|りよういん} traditionally refers to a barbershop for men, in contrast to ⟦{美容院|びよういん}→美容院：06319_biyouin⟧ (beauty salon) for women. In modern Japan, the legal distinction is more about the services offered (shaving with a razor is restricted to licensed ⟦{理容師|りようし}→理容師：24118_riyoushi⟧) than the customer's gender, but the cultural association remains strong.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{美容院|びよういん}→美容院：06319_biyouin⟧: beauty salon — historically for women, focuses on cutting, perming, and styling; cannot legally perform straight-razor shaving
- ⟦{床屋|とこや}→床屋：01682_tokoya⟧: more colloquial term for a barbershop, very common in everyday speech
- ヘアサロン: hair salon — modern, gender-neutral term used by many newer establishments
- バーバー: barber (loanword), used in some shop names

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {理容院|りよういん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go to the barbershop
- {理容院|りよういん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to get a haircut at the barbershop
- {理容院|りよういん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{髭|ひげ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{剃|そ}って→剃る：00384_soru⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧: to get a shave at the barbershop

CULTURAL NOTE:
A traditional {理容院|りよういん} typically displays a red, white, and blue spiral pole (⟦サイン→サイン：03846_sain⟧ポール) outside. The full barbershop service often includes a haircut, shampoo, and a hot-towel shave.
